home-page.splash-screen-text: Film is like a good friend, you always want to see him again.

alex-sutherland.name: Alex Sutherland
alex-sutherland.qoute-alex-sutherland: He brings all ages to life in vivid and well researched detail. His unique vision has you having to remember when you’re 120 pages into his 'AGO' series, that this is not a novel, but a scripted TV series, which has you completely captivated by the intricate world he has created.

tim-angulo.name: Tim Angulo
tim-angulo.quote: The character development is very good as the story flows and is woven around true events of the time with the right amount fictitious fun. Reading it was a cinematographer’s dream.

home-page.who-we-are-info: Stern Screenplays is a globally operating screenwriting company based in Germany. We write english screenplays for the international film and TV sector. Our themes serve a variety of genres and we are open for a cross-genre approach as well.

ago.title: AGO
ago.description: „Time forsooth has come to open our hearts shall we not perish in the battle!“

firedog.title: FIREDOG
firedog.description: „They are all outcasts, forgotten ones without hope. I live and suffer with them as this is my destiny.“

ghost-pack.title: GHOST PACK
ghost-pack.description: „If we intend to win this fucking war, we need a frigging wonder. And I will take care of that!“

heart-attack.title: HEART ATTACK
heart-attack.description: „A man's character manifests itself in every cell."

impact.title: IMPACT
impact.description: „The earth groaneth heavily, bleak and with no man left. Perdition brought upon countless lives. With a force that once created all, now merely bequeathing death.“

past-descendant.title: THE VENATOR
past-descendant.description: „I am the Guardian of your soul and Measure of your deeds. I am the Force that leads you.“

someones-gotta-do-it.title: SOMEONE'S GOTTA DO IT!
someones-gotta-do-it.description: „I am a philosophising chronicler or a chronic philosopher. That's up to you.“
